== Published English Original Virtual Set 7 wording ==
The July sheet prints an extra “The” in Agents Of Black Sun. October restores the existing title, so both 2004 slips share the same operative state. The remaster replaces the two named Objective sides with an expansion-marked Objective you own, and expressly names your deploy phase for the single non-weapon pull. The Imperial City, Scum And Villainy and Black Sun conditions remain.
